_comment: Docs review-pending policy (spec pose-docs-assessment-followups). Optional: absent means pose-mcp uses these same defaults. min_hits/level tune the docs-review hook consumer: level="direct" only counts a direct components_hit hit toward a doc ("any" also counts transitive hits); min_hits is the minimum distinct components/paths a doc must be hit by before it is marked review-pending. default_owner/review_days size the synthetic follow-up's owner and review SLA when a manifest entry doesn't declare its own owner.
